title: Fitbit Air vs. Whoop: Which screenless fitness tracker is better for you?

claims.claim: Whoop ilk takipçisini 2015 yılında piyasaya sürdü.

evidence.quote: For instance, Whoop launched its first tracker in 2015, launching as among the first, if not the first of the category.

claims.claim: Whoop, mart ayında 575 milyon dolar yatırım alarak 10 milyar dolar değerlemeye ulaştı.

evidence.quote: In March, Whoop raised $575 million, garnering itself a $10 billion valuation, signaling increased interest in the space.

claims.claim: Google, 31 Mart'ta Fitbit Air benzeri bir ürün hazırladığını duyurdu.

evidence.quote: In fact, Google teased it was preparing something like the Air on March 31 — the same day as Whoop's funding announcement.

claims.claim: Whoop 5.0 ve Whoop MG gibi newer modeller 14 günden fazla pil ömrüne sahiptir.

evidence.quote: Newer Whoop models like the Whoop 5.0 and Whoop MG are rated to last 14+ days while Google says the Fitbit Air lasts up to seven.

claims.claim: Google, Fitbit Air pilinin yedi güne kadar dayandığını belirtmektedir.

evidence.quote: while Google says the Fitbit Air lasts up to seven.
Newer Whoop models like the Whoop 5.0 and Whoop MG are rated to last 14+ days while Google says the Fitbit Air lasts up to seven.

claims.claim: ABD, Meksika, Kanada, AB ve İngiltere'de Whoop One üyeliği yıllık 199 dolara satılacaktır.

evidence.quote: According to Whoop, "Whoop One will be sold on WHOOP 5.0 hardware in the US, MX, CA, EU and UK. WHOOP One in these regions will be sold at $199/ year."

claims.claim: Fitbit Air, Google Health Premium için üç aylık deneme süresi ile birlikte gelmektedir.

evidence.quote: By contrast, the Fitbit Air comes with a three-month trial to Google Health Premium after which you can cancel or continue by paying a small fee.

claims.claim: Google Health Premium'un yıllık planı yılda 100 dolar veya aylık 10 dolardır ve donanım maliyeti 100 dolardır.

evidence.quote: Meanwhile, Google Health Premium will set you back $100 per year (with an annual plan or $10 per month) on top of the hardware cost of $100.
